title: FireHydrant
description: A fire hydrant is a fitting in a location with a nozzle by which a fire hose may be attached to a water main.

identifier.description: Any identifier issued by any authority, whether a government agency or not. Lijst van Identifier items.

geometry.description: The fire hydrant's location as a point, expressed using coordinates in some coordinate reference system. Lijst van Geometry items.

address.description: The address representation that corresponds to the fire hydrant. Lijst van AddressRepresentation items.

hasPart.description: The outlet which is physically attached to a fire hydrant. Lijst van Outlet items.

hasMaintenance.description: The maintenance the fire hydrants has or will receive. Lijst van Maintenance items.

hasUsage.description: The usage of the fire hydrant by an organization. Lijst van Usage items.

hasInspection.description: The inspection the fire hydrants has or will receive. Lijst van Inspection items.
